analyticsBody: Wannan shafin yana amfani da shi don ƙirga ziyara da shafukan da aka karanta. Idan ka ba da izini, Google zai karɓi adireshin IP ɗinka kuma zai iya saita kukis. Ƙin yarda ba laifi ba ne: shafin zai yi aiki kamar yadda yake.
genericNotice: Wannan abun ya fito ne daga {host}. {host} zai karɓi adireshin IP ɗinka kuma zai iya saita kukis.
serviceNotice_youtube: Wannan bidiyon yana kunnawa daga YouTube. Google zai karɓi adireshin IP ɗinka kuma zai iya saita kukis.
serviceNotice_vimeo: Wannan bidiyon yana kunnawa daga Vimeo. Vimeo zai karɓi adireshin IP ɗinka.
serviceNotice_google_maps: Wannan taswirar daga Google Maps take. Google zai karɓi adireshin IP ɗinka kuma zai iya saita kukis.
serviceNotice_speech: Burauzarka zai aika muryarka zuwa sabis ɗinsa na magana (Google, Apple ko Microsoft) don mayar da ita rubutu.
serviceNotice_github: Wannan abun ya fito ne daga GitHub. GitHub zai karɓi adireshin IP ɗinka kuma zai iya saita kukis.

serviceNotice_aframe: Wannan yanayin 3D yana buƙatar ɗakin karatu na A-Frame daga aframe.io. aframe.io zai karɓi adireshin IP ɗinka.
